title: Hugo
summary: Raleigh names Hugo in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Hugo, named with Beda and Thomas vpon the omission of the mothers name by S. Matthew. He is not Hugo de Sancto, who built the Castle of Thoron. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVII, §. VIII, sig. 298b
